confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Puerto Vallarta's tourist price levels for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies more by season and property. July is rainy season with some summer demand, so hotel and hostel anchors are bounded estimates. Cocktail and wine were set using the local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 0.6955 rate and its 2026-10-15 date come from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates overview page. I did not open that page directly, and a third-party site showed 0.6947 for 2026-10-16, so verify against rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Mexican Pacific resort pricing, adjusted from higher-cost Los Cabos and set near Mazatlán-level tourist pricing for restaurants and lodging. No single comparable city was used.
